ACCOUNTANT: Accountant to prepare financial statements, manage general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, reconcile bank accounts, handle tax filings and audits. Requires accounting degree, GAAP knowledge, QuickBooks or SAP and strong Excel skills.
ADVOCATE: Advocate / legal associate to draft legal documents, research case law, represent clients in court, advise on litigation and contracts, and manage case files. Requires law degree, bar membership and strong legal writing.
AGRICULTURE: Agriculture specialist to manage crop production, soil and irrigation programs, advise farmers on pest control and fertilisers, and run field trials. Requires agronomy or agricultural science background and farm operations experience.
APPAREL: Apparel merchandiser / fashion associate to develop garment collections, work with textile suppliers, manage samples, fit and production timelines, and track retail trends. Requires fashion merchandising and apparel production experience.
ARTS: Arts program coordinator to plan exhibitions, teach art and music classes, manage gallery and theatre events, and support artists and community arts programs. Requires fine arts background and event coordination.
AUTOMOBILE: Automotive technician / engineer to diagnose and repair vehicles, maintain engines, brakes and transmissions, run vehicle inspections, and support automotive service operations. Requires automobile engineering or mechanic certification.
AVIATION: Aviation professional to support aircraft maintenance and flight operations, follow FAA regulations, inspect aircraft systems, coordinate pilots and ground crew, and maintain airworthiness records. Requires aviation or aircraft maintenance experience.
BANKING: Banking officer to manage customer accounts, process loans and deposits, ensure compliance with banking regulations, handle branch operations and cross-sell financial products. Requires retail banking and credit experience.
BPO: BPO customer service associate to handle inbound and outbound calls, resolve customer queries, meet call center KPIs and process back-office transactions. Requires call center experience, good communication and CRM tools.
BUSINESS-DEVELOPMENT: Business development manager to generate leads, build client relationships, negotiate partnerships, prepare proposals and grow revenue in new markets. Requires B2B sales, market research and strategic planning experience.
CHEF: Chef to plan menus, prepare and cook dishes, manage kitchen staff, control food cost and inventory, and maintain food safety and sanitation standards. Requires culinary training and restaurant kitchen experience.
CONSTRUCTION: Construction project manager to oversee building sites, schedule subcontractors, manage budgets, read blueprints, ensure OSHA safety compliance and quality control. Requires civil or construction management experience.
CONSULTANT: Consultant to analyse client business problems, gather requirements, recommend process improvements, manage project delivery and present findings to stakeholders. Requires consulting, analysis and project management experience.
DESIGNER: Graphic / UI designer to create visual designs, branding, layouts and user interfaces using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and Figma, and collaborate with marketing and product teams. Requires a strong design portfolio.
DIGITAL-MEDIA: Digital media specialist to manage social media campaigns, create video and web content, run SEO and online advertising, and analyse digital marketing metrics. Requires content creation and digital marketing tools.
ENGINEERING: Engineer to design, test and improve mechanical, electrical or manufacturing systems, prepare technical drawings with CAD, run quality and reliability analysis and support production. Requires engineering degree.
FINANCE: Financial analyst to build financial models, budgeting and forecasting, analyse investments and variances, prepare reports for management and support financial planning. Requires finance degree and advanced Excel.
FITNESS: Fitness trainer to design workout programs, coach personal training clients and group fitness classes, track client progress and promote healthy nutrition. Requires personal trainer certification and CPR.
HEALTHCARE: Healthcare professional to provide patient care, maintain medical records, coordinate with physicians and nurses, follow clinical protocols and HIPAA. Requires clinical, nursing or medical background.
HR: Human resources generalist to manage recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, payroll and benefits administration, HR policies and performance reviews. Requires HR experience and HRIS knowledge.
INFORMATION-TECHNOLOGY: IT specialist to support networks, servers and end-user systems, manage Windows and Linux administration, troubleshoot hardware and software, and maintain IT security. Requires IT support or systems administration experience.
PUBLIC-RELATIONS: Public relations specialist to write press releases, manage media relations, plan communications campaigns and events, and protect brand reputation. Requires PR, communications and media outreach experience.
SALES: Sales representative to prospect customers, meet sales targets, manage accounts and pipeline, deliver product demos and close deals. Requires retail or B2B sales experience and strong negotiation.
TEACHER: Teacher to plan lessons and curriculum, teach students in the classroom, assess student progress, manage classroom behaviour and communicate with parents. Requires teaching certification and education degree.
